lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 출근길에 표정이 안 좋던데요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, you looked down on your way to work.
lines.beaver_roman: minsu ssi, chulgeunkkire pyojeongi an joteondeyo?
lines.learner: 실장님, 지난번 기획 결정이 계속 생각나요.
lines.en: Manager, I keep thinking about our last planning decision.
lines.roman: siljangnim, jinanbeon gihoek gyeoljeongi gyesok saenggangnayo.

lines.beaver: 해외 진출 안 하기로 한 거요?
lines.beaver_en: The decision not to expand overseas?
lines.beaver_roman: haeoe jinchul an hagiro han geoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 그때 진출했더라면 성과가 좋았을 거예요.
lines.en: Yes. If only we had expanded then, results would be better.
lines.roman: ne, geuttae jinchulhaetdeoramyeon seonggwaga joasseul geoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 성과는 어때요? 요즘 숫자가 좀 아쉽죠.
lines.beaver_en: How are the results? The numbers are a bit disappointing.
lines.beaver_roman: seonggwaneun eottaeyo? yojeum sutjaga jom aswipjyo.
lines.en: About half the target. We've lost clients too.

lines.learner: 제가 관계자를 더 만났더라면 달랐을 거예요.
lines.en: If only I had met more officials, it'd be different.
lines.roman: jega gwangyejareul deo mannatdeoramyeon dallasseul geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: There's no use regretting the past now.
lines.learner: 알아요. 그래도 작업 흐름을 바꿨더라면 좋았겠어요.
lines.en: I know. Still, I wish we had changed the workflow.
lines.roman: arayo. geuraedo jageop heureumeul bakkwotdeoramyeon joatgesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: And the salary negotiation? Anything worrying you?
lines.en: Results are low, so I'm worried about my salary.

lines.beaver_en: Running the team is my responsibility too.
lines.learner: 퇴직한 선배 조언을 들었더라면 좋았을 텐데요.
lines.en: If only I had listened to my retired senior's advice.
lines.roman: toejikan seonbae jooneul deureotdeoramyeon joasseul tendeyo.

lines.beaver: 직장 생활에 대해 더 이야기해 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Want to talk more about work life?
lines.beaver_roman: jikjang saenghware daehae deo iyagihae bollaeyo?
lines.learner: 직장 생활이 쉽지 않네요. 실수도 많았고요.
lines.en: Work life isn't easy. I made a lot of mistakes, too.
lines.roman: jikjang saenghwari swipji anneyo. silsudo manatgoyo.

lines.beaver: 다음 분기 대책을 같이 세워 봅시다.
lines.beaver_en: Let's make a plan for next quarter together.
lines.beaver_roman: daeum bungi daechaegeul gachi sewo bopsida.
lines.en: Okay, I'll start by hearing from the team members.

lines.beaver_en: Good. I'll set up a meeting this week.
lines.en: Thank you, Manager. I feel encouraged.
